ops.title: record-gt-goldens: normalize the work root so recorded paths are machine-stable
ops.description:
`internal/cli/testdata/gt/restack-worktree-held.json` carries gt's stdout
verbatim, including the recorder's own machine path:

    Did not restack branch feat because it is checked out in worktree
    /private/tmp/ccx-gt-record/restack-worktree-held/held.

Because that path is machine-specific, `TestRestackGTPerBranchVerdict`'s
worktree row can only assert a PREFIX (`skipped feat (checked out in /`) rather
than the whole summary line. The recorded path is genuine evidence of what gt
wrote and must not be hand-rewritten, so the fix belongs in the recorder:
normalize `CCX_GT_RECORD_ROOT` to a fixed token at capture time and expand it in
the loader.

Touches `scripts/record-gt-goldens.sh`, the affected goldens, and the golden
loader in `internal/cli/gtgolden_test.go`. The README already documents that the
work root "lands in any output naming a path, so those scenarios differ between
a macOS and a Linux recording" — this closes that.

ops.text: A recorded golden containing the recorder's work root carries a fixed token instead of /private/tmp/ccx-gt-record/..., and the loader expands it
restack-worktree-held's assertion can pin the whole summary line rather than a prefix
